errors.evidence: The y-axis in the image appears to start around 81-82% visually, but the reference states the range is 82% to 90%. The description also claims tick interval is 1%, but the visible ticks appear at 82, 84, 86, 88, 90 — i.e., intervals of 2%.
The reference states Precision increases to about 87% (approximately 89% visible in the image at mBERT-100). The image shows the blue line reaching approximately 89% at mBERT-100, not 88.5%.
The image shows the red (Recall) line reaching approximately 90.5% at mBERT-100, not exactly 90.0%. The reference also states it reaches approximately 90%+.
The image shows the green (F1 Score) line reaching approximately 89% at mBERT-100, which is consistent, but the reference states approximately 88%, suggesting possible slight overestimation.
The description does not mention that the x-axis tick intervals are non-uniform (mBERT-0, 10, 30, 50, 80, 100 — with unequal spacing), which is noted in the reference as an important characteristic.

errors.evidence: This phrasing is awkward and misleading — it describes the tick interval as if it were evenly spaced configurations, when in fact the intervals are non-uniform (0, 10, 30, 50, 80, 100).
